test_title: PYST 5: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:13 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.

He said to me, “How are you now?”

options.text: He asked me how was I then.
He asked me that how I was now
He asked me how I was then.
He asked me If I was well then.

solution:
The correct answer is **"Option 3".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in a **direct speech **and we need to convert it into an **indirect speech**.
 
• We follow these rules in **Direct-Indirect** speech:
 
 
• The reporting verb changed to **"asked"** in indirect speech in the case of an interrogative sentence.
 
• The **"question tag"** in direct speech changes to a **"full stop"** in indirect speech.
 
• The pronoun **"you"** changes to **"I" **in the indirect speech.
 
• If the direct speech is written in the **present tense**, then we have to change it to **past in the indirect speech**. therefore:
 
 
• The verb **"are"** in direct speech changes to **"was"** in indirect speech.
 
• The direct speech part is in the active form and we have to change it into the passive form. So, the subject becomes the object in indirect speech.
 
 
 
• The inverted commas ("...") ; are omitted to show the indirect speech part.
 
• The comma (,) is omitted to show the indirect speech part.
 
• **"Now" **in direct speech becomes** "then"** in indirect speech.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is: **"He asked me how I was then."**

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 3."**
